facts.claim: At capacity; pre-qualification closed. Pre-qualifications already on the waitlist are processed first come, first served. Financing up to 100% of project cost to $50,000, repaid on the property tax bill over the lesser of 20 years or the upgrades' useful life. Interest rate currently 1.62%, variable up to but not over 3%. Minimum project $3,000.
Residential CEIP is offered in Calgary, Edmonton, Lethbridge, St. Albert (among others). Red Deer and Wood Buffalo (Fort McMurray) are NOT on the residential list.

Edmonton residential CEIP: financing of $3,000 to $50,000, up to 100% of cost, fixed 6.00% (current tranche), term up to 20 years or the upgrades' useful life, repaid on property tax, penalty-free early payoff. At least three upgrades are required (unless fewer reach net zero or the property took part before). Not eligible in Edmonton: air conditioners, high-efficiency gas furnaces (unless combined with a heat pump), high-efficiency storage water heaters. The program is nearing capacity and new pre-qualifications go on a waitlist, first come, first served. Initial $20 million supports roughly 300 residential projects; intake pauses after 150 pre-qualifications. City FAQ: 'Currently, there are no available rebates' from the City of Edmonton.

$50 rebate for replacing your thermostat with a smart thermostat from the City's qualifying list, bought in 2026 and installed in Red Deer. Red Deer residents with a City of Red Deer utility account; one rebate per utility account; not if previously participated or using other funding programs; receipt required. Annual program; applications close when funds are spent.
facts.dates: Returned for 2026; apply by Dec 31, 2026 or until funds run out
